messages:
morgan: Heads-up — Axion exec wants a go/no-go by EOD. POC still blocked: (1) telemetry ingestion failing, (2) sustained-throughput pricing question. Need clear owners and a short unblock plan.

sasha: I can own pricing. quick q: what sustained qps are they actually expecting? need that to size Dedicated vs Hosted burst.

albert: from their perf tests last night: ~125 req/s steady, avg 4k tokens per request. they said bursts to 300 qps for short windows. cc @sasha.

ria: telemetry side — their webhook is 502ing on our collector. logs show CORS preflight failing and payload rejected with 415. pasted sample curl below.

```\nPOST /v1/telemetry HTTP/1.1
Host: ingestor.redwood.internal
Content-Type: application/json
Origin: https://axion-app.com

Response: 415 Unsupported Media Type\n```

ria: I flagged their infra team, but we can also offer a fallback: S3 drop + SQS ingestion for the test window. would be easier to get data flowing quickly.

jenna: Ops note — for 125 qps sustained + 4k tokens, recommend reserve pool of 4x A100s (or 6x T4 quantized) depending on quant profile. pricing delta is material. @sasha i can send an estimated cost delta by EOD.

charlie: (from sales-bot) Customer asked about SOC2 scope for telemetry pipeline. shared SOC2 packet link: https://redwood.internal/soc2/telemetry

sasha: thanks jenna + albert. please include two pricing lines: (A) hosted with throttling fallback, (B) Dedicated reserved commit with canary fallback. need clear $/month and monthly commit.

morgan: For exec update: brief status bullets only. 1) telemetry fallback proposed (S3/SQS) — ops to confirm. 2) pricing: hosted vs dedicated options being prepared. 3) security: SOC2 packet shared, sec questionnaire outstanding (they asked about data retention).

albert: quick answer on retention: default 30 days for POC telemetry, extendable to 90 with signed DPA.

ria: ops can stand up S3/SQS ingest in ~3 hours if they give bucket policy. sending snippet: 

```
aws s3api put-bucket-policy --bucket axion-poc-ingest --policy file://policy.json
aws sqs create-queue --queue-name axion-poc-ingest-queue
```

morgan: Ok — owners: @ria telemetry fallback, @sasha pricing, @jenna infra sizing and cost delta, @albert legal retention note. I'll draft the exec note once we have the two pricing lines and confirmation on S3 fallback.

deploy-bot: Reminder: oncall infra rotation starts in 2 hours — @jenna you are the primary.

jenna: acknowledged. i'll prioritize the sizing/cost and reach out to infra now. aiming to post pricing lines in ~90m.

sasha: i'll draft the exec one-pager template, ping for numbers.

morgan: Great. If we hit any blocker escalate to exec-bridge. low-bandwidth exec update only — 3 bullets. :thumbsup:
